parameters.name: period_mode
parameters.description: Required. Period comparison model: yoy | qoq | mom | custom

parameters.name: growth_basis
parameters.description: Optional. Growth ranking basis: sales | units | profit | margin (default: sales)

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Required when period_mode=custom. Start date in YYYY-MM-DD or m/d/Y format

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Required when period_mode=custom. End date in YYYY-MM-DD or m/d/Y format, on or after date_from

parameters.name: min_volume
parameters.description: Optional. Minimum sales volume before a product qualifies as a mover

parameters.name: sales_channel_id
parameters.description: Optional. Restrict the dashboard to a single sales channel (must exist)
